observed_original_abi.return_type_rationale: The machine has exactly one data-producing instruction: 0x008d86b0 8B 81 60 02 00 00 MOV EAX,dword ptr [ECX+0x260], followed by 0x008d86b6 C3 RET. EAX is therefore a 32-bit value copied out of the receiver. The 32-bit value at +0x260 is independently proven to be a pointer by two neighbouring functions: 0x008d86c0 loads it into EDI and dereferences it as a vtable-bearing object, and FUN_008d8c50 calls vtable slot +0x28 through param_1[0x98] which is the same +0x260 slot. The SDK-derived Ghidra prototype for this address says 'void', which the machine contradicts; the pointer return is the modelled reading and the disagreement is recorded in unresolved_questions. The pointee's EA class name is not recoverable from the binary, so ObservedIndexObject is a locally declared carrier, not an EA name.

mechanics.load: One dword read at [ECX+0x260] into EAX. Displacement is the 32-bit form 0x00000260, so the carrier must be at least 0x264 bytes.
mechanics.return: EAX is returned unchanged. There is no AddRef, no Release, no null test, no branch and no call anywhere in the 7-byte body, so the returned handle is non-owning and a null field yields a plain null return.
mechanics.no_stack_argument: The single terminator is a bare RET, not RET 0x4. Under the observed __thiscall convention the callee reclaims its own stack arguments (contrast the adjacent writer 0x008d86c0, which ends in RET 0x4 at 0x008d86fe). A bare RET therefore proves this function declares no stack parameter.
